messages.text: Morning. IG spreads gapping wider out of the gate, CDX IG up 3 bps already and HY looks heavier. Watch your inventory, bids are thin.
Seeing it. Three accounts already calling for bid lists on cash bonds. Dealers are quoting 5-10 wide of Friday on anything over 7yr.
OMS is lagging a bit on corp bond fills, anyone else? Two of my tickets took ~20 sec to ack.
Yeah noticed it too. Probably just the volume spike. If it's still slow in 15 min I'll ping Tech in #it-ops.
Client wants to sell $15mm of a BBB industrial, 10yr. Last print was +142, I'm hearing +155 now. Is that where we're showing it?
Show +158 to start, we're not stepping up to size in this tape. Work it in clips, no more than $5mm at a time.
Got it. I'll work the first $5mm clip now and leave the rest resting. Will flag fills as they come.
First clip done at +157. Second looking for a bid, nothing inside +162 so far.
Client is okay holding the rest till afternoon if we can't get +160 or better. Don't chase.
TradeBlotter P&L on the credit book is -$180k mark to market from the widening. Within limits but let's not add duration until this settles.
OMS acks are back to normal, so it was just the open crush.
Good, no need to escalate then. Keep an eye on the index into the 2pm window and ping me if CDX breaks 60.
